CELLxGENE, GEO, PubMed, CellMarker, and ligand-receptor references b"},{"id":"p21s3","text":"ecome auditable local artifacts."},{"id":"p22s1","text":"## Why QDD"},{"id":"p23s1","text":"Modern AI agents can write code, search public databases, and run analyses. The hard part is no long"},{"id":"p23s2","text":"er only execution. The hard part is keeping a multi-step scientific project coherent after every par"},{"id":"p23s3","text":"tial result, failed hypothesis, dataset limitation, or promising signal."},{"id":"p24s1","text":"QDD is built for that gap:"},{"id":"p25s1","text":"| Without QDD | With QDD |"},{"id":"p26s1","text":"| Scattered chats, scripts, notebooks, and folders | One readable research state shared by humans an"},{"id":"p26s2","text":"d agents |
| Agents optimize the next task only | Agents optimize the next question |
| Negative res"},{"id":"p26s3","text":"ults become dead ends | Negative results become pivots, validations, or robustness studies |
| Publi"},{"id":"p26s4","text":"c-data searches are hard to audit | Dataset and reference choices are recorded as reusable evidence "},{"id":"p26s5","text":"|
| Domain knowledge must be re-explained every turn | Domain skills are injected into the right rol"},{"id":"p26s6","text":"e at the right time |"},{"id":"p27s1","text":"## The Six Human Workflows"},{"id":"p28s1","text":"QDD is intentionally small. The human-facing model is five research-loop workflows plus a project-le"},{"id":"p28s2","text":"vel conclude workflow. Auto Mode covers the research loop only."},{"id":"p29s1","text":"### 1. Start"},{"id":"p30s1","text":"Establish the project contract: research theme, scope, data assumptions, runtime environment, durabl"},{"id":"p30s2","text":"e resources, and mode. This is the stable "why are we doing this?" layer."},{"id":"p31s1","text":"### 2. Propose"},{"id":"p32s1","text":"Turn the current frontier into one bounded study. A good study has a judgeable question, a falsifiab"},{"id":"p32s2","text":"le expectation, a small task graph, and explicit resource fit."},{"id":"p33s1","text":"### 3. Explore"},{"id":"p34s1","text":"Stress-test a proposed study before execution. This is where the agent and user refine boundaries, d"},{"id":"p34s2","text":"ecide whether public data is needed, and avoid over-broad or under-powered plans."},{"id":"p35s1","text":"### 4. Apply"},{"id":"p36s1","text":"Execute the study tasks. QDD injects task-local domain skills, runs code inside the project, preserv"},{"id":"p36s2","text":"es scripts and outputs, and keeps final artifacts under a canonical study output surface."},{"id":"p37s1","text":"### 5. Close"},{"id":"p38s1","text":"Synthesize evidence and update the research frontier. A close event can refine, confirm, pivot, or d"},{"id":"p38s2","text":"issolve a question. QDD records what changed, what remains open, which artifacts are reusable, and w"},{"id":"p38s3","text":"hat next candidates are worth pursuing."},{"id":"p39s1","text":"### 6. Conclude"},{"id":"p40s1","text":"Use `$qdd-conclude` in Codex or the corresponding `qdd-conclude` entry in Claude Code when the proje"},{"id":"p40s2","text":"ct is synthesis-ready. The general-purpose agent writes a cross-study research synthesis, aligns the"},{"id":"p40s3","text":" manuscript narrative with the user, writes and revises the complete `story.md`, and renders TeX onl"},{"id":"p40s4","text":"y after the user accepts that story. Conclude is human-only and is not an Auto Mode phase."},{"id":"p41s1","text":"## Auto Mode"},{"id":"p42s1","text":"Auto Mode runs the whole loop through an Anthropic-compatible SDK session:"},{"id":"p43s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p44s1","text":"It is designed for long-running research automation, not a single prompt. If you use DeepSeek as the default backend, route it through an A"},{"id":"p47s3","text":"nthropic-compatible gateway or internal proxy:"},{"id":"p48s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p49s1","text":"You can also pass the model explicitly:"},{"id":"p50s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p51s1","text":"## Domain Skill Injection"},{"id":"p52s1","text":"QDD ships with **34 local skills** that are routed by role and task instead of dumped into every pro"},{"id":"p52s2","text":"ships with **34 local skills** that are routed by role and task instead of dumped into every prompt."},{"id":"p53s1","text":"| Skill layer | Current coverage |"},{"id":"p54s1","text":"| Thesis planning | project-frontier planning and continue/stop/pivot decisions |
| Study brain | si"},{"id":"p54s2","text":"ngle-cell, spatial, and public-data planning |
| scRNA-seq | QC, integration, clustering, annotation"},{"id":"p54s3","text":", DE, group stats, module scoring, enrichment, communication, trajectory |
| scATAC-seq | LSI prepro"},{"id":"p54s4","text":"cessing, latent integration, gene-activity annotation, DAR |
| Spatial transcriptomics | QC, integra"},{"id":"p54s5","text":"tion, clustering, annotation, group stats, DE, neighborhood, niche composition, structure quantifica"},{"id":"p54s6","text":"tion |
| Public data and reference | CELLxGENE, GEO, PubMed, CellMarker, ligand-receptor resources |"},{"id":"p55s1","text":"The point is not just more tools. The point is **role-aware injection**:"},{"id":"p56s1","text":"- thesis-manager gets frontier-planning skills
- study-brain gets planning skills

[该节后续省略]"},{"id":"p57s1","text":"## What QDD Is Not"},{"id":"p58s1","text":"- It is not a clinical decision system.
- It is not a black-box cloud notebook.
- It is not a replac"},{"id":"p58s2","text":"ement for domain judgment.
- It is not a rigid workflow engine where every branch is pre-scripted."},{"id":"p59s1","text":"QDD is a protocol layer for human-agent research: local files, explicit evidence, reusable artifacts"},{"id":"p59s2","text":", and question evolution."}],"truncated":true}
